shots.name: 14-survivor-select
shots.doc: Survivor select: the four-strong roster, a rotating 3D portrait, the selected survivor's four abilities and roster-relative stat bars. Judges menu hierarchy, typography and whether the new content is legible before a run starts.

shots.name: 15-logbook
shots.doc: Logbook, survivors tab, with the 3D model viewer live. Judges the index/detail split, unlock and discovery states, and whether the browsing UI reads as the same product as the HUD.

shots.name: 16-run-summary
shots.doc: Run-end summary after a real death: survivor, difficulty, artifacts, time, stages, kills, damage, the run's item haul and anything earned. Judges whether the run reads back as a story rather than a number dump.

shots.name: 17-artifacts
shots.doc: Pre-run artifact grid: earned artifacts enabled, unearned ones showing the challenge that opens them. Judges the card grid and the active/locked state pair.

shots.name: 18-difficulty
shots.doc: Pre-run difficulty ladder with a rung selected. Judges the option-list treatment, the icon set and the selected/unselected state pair.

shots.name: 19-overkill
shots.doc: A heavy monster killed with damage to spare, photographed with the corpse mid-launch and its element's kill burst live. Judges whether a kill reads as an event.
